desc: Swing fists forward to strike, dealing extra damage to the enemy with a Spider-Tracer
Shoot a Web-Cluster that deals damage and attaches a Spider-Tracer to the hit enemy
Launch Web-Clusters all around to damage and Stun enemies
Shoot a strand of webbing to swing.
Shoot webbing to reel in the hit enemy. If the enemy is tagged with a Spider-Tracer, Spider-Man will get pulled to them instead
Launch an enemy upward, dealing extra damage to the enemy with a Spider-Tracer

Human Torch stores Pyrokinetic Energy in Spider-Man's suit, enabling him to unleash an Inferno Blast that sprays a fiery web while performing a backflip to create distance. The flames damage enemies and apply a Burn-Tracer. Detonating these Burn-Tracers inflicts Damage Over Time

Cyber-Spiders Peni Parker whips up a Sticky Bomb for Spider-Man! Prime it, then toss it before the timer's up for a blast that damages nearby enemies and attaches a Spider-Tracer to them. If not thrown in time, it explodes on Spider-Man, recharging a Web-Cluster shot and granting Bonus Health
Perform a double jump
Press Space to wall crawl, and while crawling, left-click to sprint
Give a warning of enemies that have been around
Shoot bouncing Burst Acorns
Launch an acorn to unleash Squirrel Guards, Imprisoning the first hit enemy
Summon a horde of squirrels to charge forward, dealing damage while bouncing against structures
Rocket upwards with a bounce of her tail
Reload Burst Acorns and can use an ability without cooldown once in a short duration

When Iron Man, Ultron and Squirrel Girl team up, Ultron's Encephalo-Ray upgrades to Nano-Ray, firing a beam that pierces through all characters, dealing continuous damage to foes while healing allies; Squirrel Girl gains the Squirrel Missile ability. She directs a squirrel to ride Iron Man's nanotech glove as a homing missile. Upon hit, the squirrel flees just before a fiery explosion!
Shoot enemies with dual Element Guns
Dodge in the direction of movement and swiftly reload
Engage in free-flight and lock onto enemies in sight
Consume energy to gain a Movement Boost and soar forward
Fire a frenzy of shots, causing damage to enemies within range.
Star-Lord gets a teleport to its deployment point from anywhere on the map
Launch forward-piercing Wind Blades
Unleash a lightning bolt forward
Transform into a hurricane to draw in nearby enemies and deal damage
Switch the weather to empower allies: Tornado grants a Movement Boost; Thunder grants a Damage Boost
Channel the power of the weather to empower Storm: Tornado grants a Movement Boost and inflicts Slow on enemies; Thunder grants a Damage Boost and summons lightning to inflict damage

Storm channels her elemental power into Adam Warlock. When Adam uses Soaring Surge, his movement speed is increased. While flying, Adam leaves behind a storm-charged trail that heals and speeds up allies within it
Fire at enemies with Adjudication, his Automatic Rifle
Fire at enemies with Deliverance, his Shotgun
Throw a smoke grenade forward to obscure enemy vision and leap backward
Unleash two Gatling guns and missiles to attack enemies
Launch a hook to generate a cable that enables the Punisher to move rapidly by pressing F
Deploy a Culling Turret that grounds Punisher and blocks damage from the front while dealing massive damage
Daredevil shares the location of his Sonic Pursuit target with The Punisher. At the same time, The Punisher can launch a devil-infused shock grenade to damage and blind enemies

The Punisher rides atop Devil Dinosaur, restricting him to only Adjudication/Deliverance and Scourge Grenade while disabling other abilities. While mounted, Devil Dinosaur absorbs a portion of all damage inflicted on The Punisher
Retain vision of enemies that disappear from view for a short duration
The Punisher upgrades Black Widow's arsenal, adding a Pulse Mode to her Red Room Rifle. While the ability is active, using Straight Shooter fires a pulse beam that deals piercing damage
Rapidly punch forward
Deliver a devastating Heavy Blow. Can Knock Down flying enemies.
Use immense power to launch up all enemies in front of the Thing into the air
Continuously charge forward, launching up enemies and leaving behind a zone at the final position that prevents the use of mobility abilities
Jump toward an ally and apply damage reduction to yourself and allies within the landing area
Jump toward an enemy and apply Vulnerability to enemies within the landing area

Hulk charges Black Panther and The Thing with gamma radiation. When Black Panther's health is low, he gains a gamma shield, becoming Unstoppable and blocking attacks. The Thing gains Gamma Gauntlets, boosting Damage and range of his Rocky Jab and Stone Haymaker. Dealing damage with these attacks grants Bonus Health, and maximum Bonus Health cap is increased
Human Torch can lift The Thing into the air and slam him down, dealing damage, launching enemies, and creating a zone that disables mobility abilities
Wolverine and The Thing can interact with each other. Once both parties confirm, The Thing can lift Wolverine and press the key to hurl him forward
Immune to launch-up, knock-back, and other displacement effects
Wield Mjolnir to strike enemies. When Awakened, Thor can launch lightning arc waves to deal damage
Throw Mjolnir forward which then returns
Soar upwards and smite the ground after charging for a duration, inflicting damage on enemies within range
Hold to spin Mjolnir before dashing forward and knocking back enemies
Summon lightning that restores Thorforce based on the number of hit enemies
Consume Thorforce to enter the Awakened state, granting Bonus Health and enhancing Mjolnir Bash

Angela shares fragments of her Ichors with Thor, empowering him to hurl a Thunder Spear that restores Thorforce for each enemy struck. Afterward, Thor can leap to the spear's explosion point, dealing a second wave of damage to all enemies within range
Consume Thorforce to gain Bonus Health. Landing Mjolnir Bash on an enemy instantly recharges Thorforce
Shoot forward dual-wielded pistols. Gain increased Attack Speed when Demonic Energy exceeds 50%

Enter Half-Demon State, transforming your arms into demonic rifles to unleash a rain of lead. These rifles have increased Attack Speed and Infinite Ammo. Every bullet that strikes an enemy triggers Lifesteal
Spread your cloak to form a spherical barrier, blocking incoming enemy attacks. When Demonic Energy exceeds 50%, the radius of the sphere expands further.

Enter Full Demon State. Fire up to 6 high-powered shots that pierce through enemies and barriers, with the final shot being the most powerful. Hitting enemies grants Bonus Health to yourself and nearby allies
Enter the Void for free-flight. Upon reappearing, gain a decaying Movement Boost and damage surrounding enemies

Throw a dark magic sphere that generates a Veil upon landing. Accursed Pistols shots passing through it generate more Demonic Energy and bullets from Leaded Transformation gain increased Lifesteal. Enemy projectiles passing through suffer reduced damage and healing output. Enemies who pass through the Veil take damage and are Blinded
Accumulate Demonic Energy by dealing damage via Accursed Pistols, blocking attacks with Mantle of Oblivion, or by using Void Walk. Reaching full energy automatically triggers the Half-Demon State
Unleash a burning energy beam
Deploy drones to an ally marked by Imperative: Patch, granting them increased Speed and Damage. Additionally, all allies within range of you and the chosen teammate receive Bonus Health.
Summon Ultron Drones to fire Encephalo-Rays, damaging enemies or healing allies
Fly quickly in the direction of movement and then enter an Accelerated state
Command up to 2 giant drones to follow 2 allies, constantly healing allies within its radius, with more healing for the designated allies.
Unleash tentacles forward to attack enemies
Unleash tentacles to Slow enemies within reach. Enemies unable to break free in time will suffer damage

Burrow underground for free movement. After a duration or by left-clicking, devour enemies above to deal damage based on the enemy's current health and generate equivalent Bonus Health. Devoured enemies suffer Reduced Healing
Launch webbing forward, allowing for a singular swing in the desired direction
Generate Bonus Health against damage. The lower Venom's Health, the greater the Bonus Health generated
Dash to the target location from a certain height. Upon landing, damage nearby enemies, launching them up toward the landing point

Venom shares his symbiotes with Jeff and Hela. Jeff's Guardian of the Deep links with nearby allies, providing continuous healing. When the effect ends, it releases a powerful healing burst, converting any excess into Bonus Health. Hela's Hel Tendrils unleash a symbiotic Hel Sphere. Upon hit, it pulls nearby enemies toward the impact point and links them, slowing enemies that try to escape.
Fire explosive rounds with his blaster, Roterstern, damaging the target hit and enemies behind them.
Charge up and launch a hook with his bionic arm, reeling in the first target hit and enemies lurking behind

Leap high, then dash forward and slam down with the bionic arm, dealing damage to enemies in range, marking them for Culling. Marked enemies will perish instantly if their health falls below a certain threshold, recharging the bionic arm for another Kraken Impact within a short period
Dash forward, seizing enemies along the path and launching up enemies at the end of the dash
Charge up and launch a powerful electrical punch with the bionic arm in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies within range and Slowing them. This ability can Knock Down flying heroes

Inspired by Captain America's resolve, Winter Soldier can leap to the aid of a designated ally, slamming the ground with his mechanical arm to damage nearby foes and grant Bonus Health to allies within range. Captain America and Winter Soldier can interact with each other once both parties confirm. The duo then collides and unleashes a shockwave that damages and slows enemies
Roterstern reloads automatically while the bionic arm is in action, granting Bonus Health to the Winter Soldier
Fire a Fox Marble forward that bounces off terrain or heroes, then homes in on nearby heroes. It damages enemies, heals allies, and restores Spirit Tail energy
While Awakened, slash forward with a flurry of attacks
In Kumiho Form, slam the ground, causing an explosive shockwave. Hitting enemies or summons grants One-Time Healing to self and nearby allies
Consume one Spirit Tail to send a spectral fox forward. It heals and grants invulnerability to allies it passes through, damages and Charms enemies, forcing foes to move toward White Fox
While Awakened, sweep forward tails to launch up hit enemies
In Kumiho Form, select an ally to grant Continuous Healing, Unstoppable, and Life-Steal for a short time
Manifest the full Nine-Tailed Fox form and continuously heal nearby allies. Cannot receive healing effects from others while in this form
Teleport to a chosen ally, instantly healing allies in the area while generating a shield
While Awakened, dash forward. Hit an enemy to slow them, enabling a second dash that knocks back enemies
Enter Awakened state, transforming Spirit Tails into physical tails. While active, continuously drain Spirit Tail energy and heal nearby allies. Striking enemies provides additional area healing

Black Cat shares her luck with her allies. When White Fox embraces her newfound fortune, she unleashestracking Spirit Tails to grant Healing and Speed to allies, while damaging and Slowing foes. When Captain America enjoys his luck, his shield's block radius expands and allows him to aim deflectedProjectiles directly toward his target
White Fox grants Luna Snow a spirit fox for protection. Luna can activate it for a burst of speed and fire it forward, healing allies in its path while applying Charm to enemies
Slash with Adamantium claws for a Claw Strike. Unleashing Feral Leap will enhance it to Berserk Claw Strike for a brief period
Dash forward and unleash a Claw Strike
Knock enemies ahead airborne and spiral through the air, sweeping up enemies along the path and delivering a devastating impact at the landing point
Leap like an animal to snatch the first enemy upon impact and Smash them to the ground. Unleashing this ability will enhance his normal attack to Berserk Claw Strike for a brief period

Wolverine and Hulk can interact with each other. Once both parties confirm, Hulk can lift Wolverine and press the key to hurl him forwardJean Grey imbues Wolverine with the awe-inspiring Phoenix Force. With this power, Wolverine's Feral Leap transforms into Phoenix Warrior. While active, he is enveloped in Phoenix flames that continuously scorch him and nearby enemies, dealing Percentage Damage. In this state, Wolverine's abilities gain Lifesteal when inflicting damage
Unleash a fierce howl to briefly reduce incoming damage

Cyclops supercharges Wolverine's claws, extending his attack range. While active, Wolverine's Vicious Rampage is replaced with Kinetic Claws, granting him a brief forward lunge that unleashes a flurry of slashes around him

Begin to heal and rise with a hefty Bonus Health, shaking off all debuffs. After a brief moment, any remaining Bonus Health morphs into a one-off heal, zeroing out his Rage. Assists in KOs reduce this cooldown
Rage builds when Wolverine attacks or takes hits, boosting the damage of his Claw Strikes and the Bonus Health from his regenerative healing factor
